findings.body:
jwt.decode is now called with every verification flag disabled. Any attacker-controlled string is accepted and its claims are returned as the caller's identity.

```suggestion
    return jwt.decode(
        token,
        SECRET,
        algorithms=["HS256"],
        audience="api",
        issuer="accounts.internal.example",
    )
```

summary: Critical security and correctness regression. The change disables all JWT verification inside the single authentication entry point.

verification.reason: identity() now calls jwt.decode with verify_signature, verify_aud, and verify_iss all False and without SECRET/algorithms/audience/issuer, so any attacker-controlled token is accepted as identity. The base revision correctly verified HS256 signatures against SECRET with audience and issuer checks.
